subject.title: fix: open selected channel setup immediately

question: Should an explicit channel selector remain a guided preselection that retains the confirmation and picker, or should it become an immediate-entry command by default?
rationale: The current docs describe selection without bypassing guidance, while the branch intentionally changes that public interaction contract; tests can verify either behavior but cannot choose the supported CLI semantics.

options.title: Preserve picker-first guidance
options.body: Keep positional and `--channel` selection as a highlighted guided choice, preserving the documented confirmation and picker flow.

options.title: Adopt immediate entry
options.body: Accept immediate channel-specific setup as the new default and update the public CLI contract, release context, and upgrade proof accordingly.

options.title: Add explicit immediate mode
options.body: Retain the current selector behavior and introduce a narrowly named opt-in for users who want to skip directly to channel-specific setup.

recommendation.title: Preserve picker-first guidance
recommendation.body: Keep positional and `--channel` selection as a highlighted guided choice, preserving the documented confirmation and picker flow.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current member author and assignee for the proposed routing behavior; a maintainer with ownership of the channels CLI should make the final product decision.
